name: xmltv
description: French TV guide of xmltv.digital3d.com: channels, schedules, what is on air now, search and best rated programs. Read-only, through the MCP server of the API.

api_key.title: XMLTV API key
api_key.description: Your API key (a GUID), shown at https://digital3d.com/MyAccount once you have an account. Free: 10 requests per day; the subscription at https://digital3d.com/XmltvAbo?src=mcp gives more. Leave empty to use only the channel and category lists.
